About
Tata Play Fiber is a subsidiary of Tata Play Limited, co-owned by The Tata Group, The Walt Disney Company India, and Temasek Holdings. The company is dedicated to empowering customers with the first pan-India Fiber to the Home (FTTH) broadband infrastructure.
Use case: Leadership developement, employee feedback
Business challenges
Tata Play Fiber aimed to leverage a scientific tool for potential assessment while identifying gaps in their current learning & development (L&D) design. The goal was to formulate a new strategy and upgrade the employee feedback approach.
Solution
Customized leadership tests to assess leadership competencies.
Report generation with insightful data.
Impact
Shift to holistic assessments with 360-degree feedback.
Streamlined L&D process.
91 professionals underwent leadership assessment.
E-learning adoption in the company grew from 33% to 73%.
Masai is an outcome-driven career school that started in June 2019 to tap into the youth of India with the immense potential to be trained in the skills needed to be employable in the information technology (IT) job market.
Use case: Applicant screening
How to assess the English proficiency of potential applicants?
How to conduct credible exams and an ideal screening/interview process?
Enabled a customized SpeechX assessment to assess speaking ability in particular.
A remote proctoring platform with a secure browser where all tabs apart from the exam tab were disabled to minimize cheating.
Access to a test library comprising one lakh+ questions with advanced role-based simulators.
100 to approximately 1 lakh (1000X) interviews conducted.
15000 hours, equivalent to 8 years of effort and time, were saved after implementing SpeechX.
Accurate cut-off score shortened the screening time and helped shortlist the right candidates for the interview process.
Founded in 1973, the Indian Institute of Management Bangalore (IIMB) is a premier public business school in India, ranked 2nd by the National Institutional Ranking Framework (NIRF) 2020. IIMB successfully transitioned to an online examination platform, enabling over 1.2 million learners across 190 countries to partake in assessments.
Use case: Online examination
IIMB sought to provide a secure, scalable, and accessible examination platform while preserving academic integrity. The rapid growth of digital learning posed risks that the institute aimed to mitigate through enhanced examination protocols.
Mercer | Mettl's automated reporting replaced static grading, increasing faculty productivity and enhancing operational efficiency.
Mercer | Mettl's platform accommodated IIMB's growing enrollment, supporting 100,000 proctored assessments in a single day across 190 countries.
IIMB transitioned smoothly to the online platform, which replicated a traditional exam environment while remaining user-friendly and easy to navigate.
95% accuracy in cheating detection.
Instantaneous result generation.
Authentic certifications for deserving students.
CHRIST is a premier educational institute based in Bengaluru. It was established in 1969 as CHRIST College and declared a deemed-to-be-university in 2008 for adopting global higher education practices and offering a holistic education.
Move from offline to online examinations with a dynamic examination platform, high integrity, global accessibility, flexibility in proctoring and custom slotting.
EXAMIN, a proficient and end-to-end online exam management system with an automated pre-exam planning process that could scale as per the load generated.
Provided 24X7 client and candidate support, keeping the software up-to-date, compatible, and error-free.
CHRIST shifted over 43,000 students online without worrying about test-takers’ location or any technical glitches.
The auto-grading functionality helped conserve substantial time otherwise spent evaluating answer sheets

Modern Foods, a brand that introduced the concept of bread to India, was launched in 1965 as Modern Bakeries (India) Limited. It later rebranded as Modern Foods and branched into newer portfolios with multiple product offerings in the bread and cake domain. The company has 100,000 stores, manufacturing in 40 factories across India.

A standardized and focused sales hiring strategy to build a high-performing sales unit
Identifying high-potentials from its existing sales team.
A virtual assessment and development center was implemented for easy scalability, logistical comfort, and ease of access for candidates.

Reduction in new-hire attrition in sales by 33%
Improvement in screening accuracy by 66%
Improvement in performance of 75% of candidates hired through Mercer | Mettl’s assessments
Set up 1981, Coforge Ltd. has a footprint in over 30 countries and offers training and development solutions to individuals, enterprises and institutions. It ranks among the world’s top training companies owing to its comprehensive array of talent development programs. Coforge Ltd. has been named among the ‘Top 20 Training Outsourcing Companies’ for the past twelve consecutive years by Training Industry, Inc., The USA.
Use Case: Digital Assessments, Proctoring
The absence of a dynamic online assessment platform to simplify and scale its assessment and hiring process to make informed decisions.
The unavailability of quality assessments to comprehensively assess coders’ aptitude and skills - evaluating such skills helped determine their role fitment.
Mercer | Mettl helped Coforge Ltd. improve hiring quality and reduce effort by replacing a manual recruitment process with integrated digital assessments. This allowed the company to continue identifying top programming talent while making the hiring process more efficient.
The assessment solution combined cognitive and technical tests with a large question bank and customizable test creation. This gave Coforge Ltd. a flexible way to evaluate candidates across aptitude, technical skills, and role-specific requirements at different difficulty levels.
Strong proctoring, AI-based anti-cheating controls, and detailed analytics improved test integrity and decision-making. Coforge Ltd. could monitor candidates in real time, detect suspicious behavior, and use reporting to reject unsuitable applicants more accurately.
Coforge Ltd. streamlined and automated its lateral hiring process, reducing time, cost, and effort while making recruitment more efficient.
The assessments improved coder quality and candidate screening accuracy, helping Coforge Ltd. hire top tech talent faster and distinguish strong performers from weak ones.
Strong validation and reliable results increased confidence in the assessments for future hiring drives, while also reducing manual effort for hiring managers and supporting more flexible team building.
